pair_created_with_salt_included.meaning: the pair for the launched token was created by createPair using a salt that includes _launchpadLp and _launchpadFeeDistributor

pairfor_inputs_token0_token1_hash.meaning: the pair address used by endRewards was computed by pairFor from token0, token1, and uniV2InitCodeHash

end_rewards_completes.meaning: endRewards successfully terminates the rewards accrual process for the launched token without reverting

end_rewards_reverts_occurred.meaning: endRewards reverts due to an invalid pair address

assumptions: endRewards is invoked for a launched token whose pair was created by createPair in GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol.
The pair address passed to distributor.endRewards is the one computed by pairFor in endRewards.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call endRewards or any authorization condition; the plan therefore does not encode a caller qualifier.

Report does not give the exact salt formula or the concrete pairFor inputs beyond token0, token1, uniV2InitCodeHash, so the address-inequality relation between computed and actual pair addresses is not encoded numerically.

limitations: The pair-address mismatch is represented only through the report-stated revert outcome, not as an explicit address inequality, because the salt formula is not reported.
Only the end_rewards_reverts impact is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
